summary_md: **Arky Yang ([@arkyyang](https://x.com/arkyyang/status/2115800145203986579))** explains *Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory* ([arXiv 2610.34073](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34073)), which compares 11 agent memory systems with plain RAG over raw chat history and finds plain RAG often wins; memory fixes some questions but breaks others RAG already answered, a loss the authors call the memory tax.

referenced_urls.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory

relevance: Argues for always baselining agent memory against plain retrieval.
